summary: BUG-591 fix verified: Status View (Preparing/Ready/Served columns) now sorts cards by createdAt ascending. Walk-In ₹155 (37m) is last in Preparing; WAYN ₹210 (80d) is first in Served. Channel View regression confirmed unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: ChannelColumn.jsx L121-128: Fix is correct — createdAt string comparison works for ISO timestamps. Edge case: items with missing createdAt pushed to end (L125-126) — correct behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-591 fix verified. Status View sorts by createdAt ASC. Channel View (Dine-In/Room) unaffected. sortByActiveFirst in statusHelpers.js unchanged.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: groupingMode=status branch was calling sortByActiveFirst() which used label numeric sort (WAL → NaN → 0 floated to top, Table 14 → 14 sank to bottom). Fix: replaced with inline createdAt ascending comparator in ChannelColumn.jsx L121-128 for status-mode only.
